blobbyvolley2.title: Blobby Volley 2

source.imported: Upstream tree imported into this repository at 6f66ea2 (Blobby Volley 2 0.9c, the SourceForge project's code as mirrored on GitHub); build-amiga.sh builds it as imported, with patches/ applied to a copy

blobbyvolley2.contentPolicy: GPL-2.0-or-later engine and game data (Jonathan Sieber, Daniel Knobe, Sven Rech and contributors; graphics by Silvio Mummert, beach image by Richard Bertrand; COPYING, AUTHORS); Lua 5.1 MIT and TinyXML zlib, bundled in src/; RakNet (BSD-3-Clause) is not built. The data ships in the upstream repository and is packaged beside the program.

excluded: data/gf2x (old graphics the game does not load)
data/scripts/old (old bots upstream does not install)
data/server.xml and data/onlineserver.xml (network play is not built)
